[PORTAL] window.__portal installed — click a block, then:
  await __portal.open()          the whole projection
  await __portal.openMaster('fm:attention')  one type anchor
  await __portal.room('fm:attention')        materialize its room
  await __portal.enterRoom('fm:attention')   …and stand in it
  await __portal.deviate('fm:attention', sourceEdn)  retain master candidate
  await __portal.deviate('fm:attention', overridesEdn, subjectUid)  instance deviation
  __portal.preview('fm:attention', sourceEdn) / __portal.endPreview()  client-only
  await __portal.say('fm:attention', subjectUid, 'one line', optsEdn)
  await __portal.activate('fm:attention', revisionId, optsEdn)
  await __portal.rollback('fm:attention', offeredRevisionId, optsEdn)
  await __portal.workshop.open(); __portal.workshop.compose(editEdn)
  __portal.workshop.preview(); await __portal.workshop.retain(); await __portal.workshop.activate(); await __portal.workshop.reverse()
  await __portal.questions()     every question + its replayable call
  await __portal.briefing()      what a resident summoned here reads
  await __portal.release()       wish → code → receipts → verb → binding → activation → worn
  await __portal.render()        the code-floor cards
  await __portal.why('{:material/master "fm:attention" :material/site :block/user-hit-area}')
  await __portal.blast('[:scope/all-unpinned]')
  await __portal.at('{"fm:text-body" "<pointer-revision-id>"}')
  (why/blast/at take EDN STRINGS — a JS object cannot say keyword)
